answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an ocean bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every shale settlement recomputes the cipher schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 33 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
